items.title: Samana debuts premium COLLECTA brand with World Islands flagship
items.summary: Samana's new premium brand COLLECTA opens with a flagship at The World Islands of 840 branded residences (studios to four bedrooms) plus seven floating villas and two tree villas; prices are expected to start under AED 2 million and GDV exceeds AED 4 billion.

items.project: Aljada residential blocks (forward purchase from Arada)
items.title: Aldar makes Sharjah debut with Dh1.1bn Aljada forward purchase
items.summary: Aldar is buying more than 1,100 homes across nine buildings in three residential blocks at Arada's Aljada under a Dh1.1bn forward-purchase deal for its develop-to-hold portfolio, with handover expected in Q4 2029.

items.project: Mondrian Al Marjan Island Beach Residences
items.title: AED 73m four-home deal at Mondrian Al Marjan Island; project 75% sold
items.summary: A North American buyer acquired two penthouses, a townhouse and a residence for AED 73 million; the developer says the project is 75% sold with piling 80% complete and has released new beachfront two-bedroom units.

items.title: ALAIN and Rove break ground on Rove Home Meydan Horizon
items.summary: Construction has started on the 19-storey tower in MBR City with 190 furnished one- and two-bedroom apartments; handover is targeted for Q1 2029.
